# Code quality standards
<!-- Generated by project-init v0.4.1. Details and reasons: docs/standards/code-quality.md -->

## Enforced
- Code passes `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, strict `mypy` and `lint-imports`. The tools decide style.

## Adopting
- Give public modules, classes and functions in `src/` a PEP 257 docstring: purpose, arguments, return value and errors raised.
- Write `TODO` and `FIXME` as `TODO(#n): ...` with a GitHub issue number.
- Delete dead code instead of commenting it out. Update or remove a comment in the same change that makes it wrong.
- When you notice debt you aren't fixing, say so and propose a `tech-debt` issue with its impact. Don't create the issue without approval.
- Profile before changing code for performance, and put the before and after numbers in the PR.
